relations.subject: John Wilson
relations.evidence: From 1819 he attended the University of Edinburgh, where he studied linguistics, philosophy and theology for eight years... He graduated from the university in 1828.

relations.subject: John Wilson
relations.evidence: In 1857 Wilson helped to establish the Bombay University, and went on to become its Vice-Chancellor in 1869.

relations.subject: John Wilson
relations.evidence: He founded the Oriental Christian Spectator, 1830.

relations.subject: John Wilson
relations.evidence: Wilson first established an English school name Wilson High School at Girgaon in 1832, and added a college in 1836 - now called Wilson College, Mumbai.
